lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: Lady Fred. Told me to find you here.

lines.speaker: Miss Ruth
lines.text: Are you saying Miss Frieda sent you?

lines.speaker: Miss Ruth
lines.text: Oh, darling. Take this cookie. You look in such a bad shape.

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: The monsters are trying to take me, as they did with my brother.

lines.speaker: Miss Ruth
lines.text: Child, you have been so brave coming here.

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: When monsters are near, I feel different.

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: I feel like my brother is still helping me.

lines.speaker: Miss Ruth
lines.text: He surely is, but this can't be like this forever.

lines.speaker: Miss Ruth
lines.text: You can't keep hiding. I will talk to Miss Frieda tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Miss Ruth
lines.text: I might have a way of getting you out of here.

lines.speaker: Miss Ruth
lines.text: For now, keep hiding in the women's dorm room.

lines.speaker: Miss Ruth
lines.text: Hello again, sweetie. How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: A bit better, Miss Ruth. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Miss Ruth
lines.text: Good. Remember to go hide. We don't want the guards to find you.
